does: The main menu page's command run when the page is Loaded: when the graphic settings ask for a calibration (ShowGammaCalibration) and the display is not HDR, raises the UI event OpenGammaCalibration, which opens GammaCalibration under MainMenu.

evidence.says: with ShowGammaCalibration 1 in the copy's graphicSettings.lsx and ShowFirstTimeSetup false, the UI state GammaCalibration (parent MainMenu) was entered 73 ms after MainMenu; accepting it wrote ShowGammaCalibration 0
The macOS build's symbols hold this name; nothing but the name ties it to this function
